title: 📖 Active & Passive Voice (कर्तृवाच्यम् / कर्मवाच्यम्)
description: Learn to transform sentences between active and passive voice.

sections.title: 📖 What is Voice?
sections.content: Voice tells us whether the subject is doing the action (active) or receiving the action (passive).

comparison.translation: The fruit is eaten by Rama.

how_to_form_passive.rule: Add 'य' to the verb root + appropriate endings

questions.question: What is the passive form of 'पठति'?
questions.explanation: 'पठ्यते' is the passive form of 'पठति' (is read).

questions.question: Translate: 'रामेण फलं खाद्यते।'
options: The fruit is eaten by Rama.
Rama is eaten by the fruit.
questions.explanation: 'रामेण फलं खाद्यते।' means 'The fruit is eaten by Rama.'
